items.headline: Open-sourced ReliabilityGate - gates AI agent actions based on measured reliability, per-action
items.summary: Every agent framework gives you tools and permissions, but none answers: "has this agent proven it can do this action reliably?" I built ReliabilityGate -- a small Apache-2.0 Python package that gates agent actions based on measured reliability, per-action. The problem Your agent has permission to send emails. But should it?
